'''Letice Murow''' a [[novice]] in the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] camp.
 
==Appearance==
She has pale eyes and is in her middle years.

==History==
She is from [[Murandy]]. 

Egwene thinks that she once had a title and that her unblemished skin shows that she has never had to work outside in her life.

==Activities==
She and her sister both become novices in Murandy. She and her sister are placed in different novice families once they enroll. She has barely seen her since becoming a novice.  

[[Leane Sharif]] tells her that her meeting with her sister will have to wait and orders her to hold onto [[Egwene al'Vere]]'s horse until a groom arrives. Egwene has a private word with Leane later and suggests that Letice should be allowed to see her sister.
